name: ue-perfectworld
description: Stage-gated Unreal Engine development workflows (S0-S6) for planning, implementation, investigation, review, Blueprint collaboration, onboarding, and development documentation.

interface.shortDescription: UE 项目的阶段门禁开发工作流：规划、实现、审查、排查、蓝图协作、开发文档。
interface.longDescription: UE PerfectWorld enforces a stage-gated workflow for Unreal Engine development: S0 requirement intake, S1 evidence base, S2 change specification, S3 implementation, S4 verification, S5 adversarial review, S6 delivery. All stages require project-specific evidence before code is written, and a blocking final self-review before delivery. Includes investigation workflows for root-cause analysis, Blueprint collaboration rules, and development documentation generation.
defaultPrompt: 用 UE PerfectWorld 规划这个 Unreal Engine 功能
用 UE PerfectWorld 排查这个 UE bug 的根因
